title.en: Discourse of Imam Reza (a) regarding Aashura
title.rurdu: Aashura ke mutaliq Imam Reza (a) ka bayaan

desc.en: Shaikh Saduq (r) narrated from Imam Reza (a) who said: One who refrains from seeking his (worldly) desires on the day of Ashura, Allah (swt) shall grant him his desires of this world and the hereafter. The one for whom the day of Ashura is a day of tragedy, grief and weeping, Allah, the Mighty, the Glorious, shall make the Day of Judgment, a day of joy and happiness for him. If one considers the Day of Ashura to be a blessed day for him and hoards things up in his house on that day, whatever he hoards up will not be blessed. He will be resurrected along with Yazeed, Ubaydillah ibn Ziyad and Umar ibn Saa’d, may Allah damn them, on the Resurrection Day.” Rayyaan ibn Shabeeb says that I went to meet Imam Ali Reza (a) on the first day of the month of Moharram. Imam Reza (a) asked me, “O son of Shabeeb! Are you in the state of fasting today”? I replied in the negative. Imam (a) continued, “This is the day when Prophet Zakariyyah (a)’s prayer was fulfilled.

Then Imam (a) further said: O son of Shabeeb! If you wish to mourn and lament over anyone, do so upon Hussain ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (a) for he was beheaded like a lamb. Eighteen persons from among his family, who were unparalleled in the earth, were also killed along with him. The heavens and the earth lamented on the death of Hussain. Four thousand Angels descended from the heavens to aid him, but when they reached there they saw that he had already been martyred. Thus, now they all remain near his blessed grave with disheveled hair covered with dust until the rising of the Qaem (Imam al-Mahdi (a)). Then they will all aid him and their slogan will be…

trans.en: Vengeance for the blood of Hussain (a).

desc.en: O son of Shabeeb! My father (Imam Moosa Kazim (a)) has related from his father (Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (a)), who has related from his grandfather (Imam Ali Zainul Aabedeen (a)), that when my grandfather Imam Hussain (a) was martyred, the sky rained blood and red sand. O son of Shabeeb! If you weep over the afflictions of Hussain (a) such that tears flow from your eyes and fall upon your cheeks, Allah will forgive all your sins whether major or minor and less or large in number. O son of Shabeeb! If you desire to meet Allah, the Glorified, in a state purified of all sins, then go for the pilgrimage to the shrine of Imam Hussain (a). O son of Shabeeb! If you desire that you may abide in the palaces of Paradise in the company of the Holy Prophet (s) and his Progeny, then invoke Allah’s curse upon the murderers of Imam Hussain (a). O son of Shabeeb! If you desire to earn the reward of those who were martyred along with Imam Hussain (a), then whenever you remember him (a), say…

arabic.text: یَا لَیْتَنِیْ كُنْتُ مَعَہُمْ فَاَفُوْزَ فَوْزًا عَظِیْمًا۔

lines.rarabic: YAA LAIY-TANEE KUNTO MA’HUM FA-AFOOZA FAWZAN A’ZEEMA.

trans.en: I wish I had been with them, then I too would have attained the Great Triumph.
trans.rurdu: Kaash mai un (Imam Husain (as)) ke saath hota to azeem kaamyaabi tak pohonch jaata.
trans.urdu: کاش میں ان کے ساتھ ہوتا تو عظیم کامیابی تک پہنچ جاتا۔

desc.en: O son of Shabeeb! If you desire to reside in the exalted status of Paradise along with us, then bemoan our sorrows and sufferings and rejoice in our happiness and remain attached to our love. For even if a person is attached to a stone in this world, Allah shall make him arise with it on the day of Qeyaamah. Then Imam Reza (a) said: The first day of Muharram is the day when Prophet Zakariyyah (a) prayed to his Lord thus Lord grant me from unto You a good offspring, Verily You are the Hearer of Prayers. Then Allah accepted his prayers and commanded His Angels to go and give him glad tidings regarding the birth of his son Prophet Yahya (a). Imam Reza (a) said: Hence the one who fasts on this day and asks for his desires from Allah (swt), his prayer will be answered as was of Prophet Zakariyah (a).

Ja’far ibn Isa said the following: “I once asked Imam Reza (a) about fasting on Ashura and what people say about it. He (the Imam (a)) said, It is the fast of ibn Marjanah. You are asking me about the day in which the adopted ones of the family of Ziyad for their murdering Imam Hussain (a) were fasting. It is an ominous day for the family of Muhammad, (a). For people of Islam it is an ominous day. A day, which is ominous for the people of Islam is not a day of fasting or a day of blessing. Monday is an unblessed day because Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, took His Holy prophet (s), O Allah! grant compensation to Muhammad (s) and his family (a) worthy of their services to Your cause, from this world. The family of Muhammad (a) has been hurt on Monday, so we took it as an ominous day and our enemies took it as a day of blessing.”

title.en: Curse on Yazeed and his Followers
title.rurdu: Yazeed aur uske pairo-kaaro’n par laanat

desc.en: Raawandi narrates in the book ‘Namaz al-Hazeen’ on the authority of Fazl Ibn Shaazan who said: I heard Imam Reza (a) saying: When they took the decapitated head of Imam Hussain ibn Ali (a) to Sham, Yazeed, may Allah damn him, ordered that it be put somewhere and the tablecloth be spread. He, may Allah damn him and his companions, started to eat and drink beer. When they finished eating, he ordered that they put the head in a tub in front of his couch and place the chess board over the tub. Yazeed, may Allah damn him, started playing chess with his companions while he was swearing at Imam Hussain (a), his forefathers and grandfather (a) and making fun of them. Whenever he won the game, he drank three mugs of beer. Then he poured down the little bit of leftover beer on the ground right next to the tub in which Imam Hussain’s (a) head was placed. Allah, Mighty and Majestic be He, will eliminate the sins of whoever sees beer or a chess board and remembers Imam Hussain (a), and damns Yazeed and the Aal’e Ziyad, even if the number of his sins are as many as there are stars in the sky Abdul Salaam ibn Saleh Harawi said that he had heard Imam Reza (a) saying, The first person for whom beer was made during the era of Islam in Syria was Yazeed, may Allah damn him. He was sitting at the spread-out tablecloth with the decapitated head of Imam Hussain (a) there, when they brought him some beer. He drank some and personally served beer to his companions. The God damned Yazeed told his companions, ‘Drink this since it is a blessed drink! If it was not blessed, we would not have been the first ones to drink it with the head of our enemy in front of us, and our tablecloth spread out. We are eating and drinking with perfect calm and peace of mind.’ Whoever is one of our followers should abstain from drinking beer, since it is the drink for our enemies. Whoever does not abstain is not one of our followers. My father (a) narrated that his father (a) quoted on the authority of Ali ibn Abi Talib (a) that Allah’s Prophet (s) said, Do not wear the clothes of our enemies. Do not eat our enemies’ food. Do not follow what our enemies follow. Should you do so you are one of our enemies just as they are.

title.en: Supplication of Hazrat Fatema Zahra (s) On the Day of Judgement
title.rurdu: Roz’e Qayaamat ke din Hazrat Fatema Zahra (s) ki manzelat

desc.en: Abu Ahmad ibn Sulaiman al-Taaee, on the authority of Imam Reza (a) in Madinah in the year 194 A.H. (809 A.D.), on the authority of his father Moosa ibn Ja’far (a), on the authority of his father Ja’far ibn Muhammad (a), on the authority of his father Muhammad ibn Ali (a), on the authority of Ali ibn Hussain (a), on the authority of his father Hussain ibn Ali (a), on the authority of his father Ali ibn Abi Talib (a) that Allah’s Prophet (s) said, My daughter (the Blessed Lady) Fatema (s) will be resurrected on the Resurrection Day with a shirt stained with blood, will grab onto one of the pillars of the Throne and say…

arabic.text: يَا اَحْكَمَ الْـحَاكِمِيْنَ اُحْكُمْ بَيْنِيْ وَبَيْنَ قَاتِلِ وَلَدِيْ۔

lines.rarabic: YAA AH-KAMAL HAAKE-MEENA OH-KUM BAIY-NEE WA BAIY-NA QAATELE WALADEE.

trans.en: O the Judge of the judges! Judge between me and the murderers of my son.
trans.rurdu: Ay sab se beh-tareen faisla karne waale mere aur mere bete ke qaatil ke darmiyaan faisla kar.
trans.urdu: اے سب سے بہترین فیصلہ کرنے والے میرے اور میرے بیٹے کے قاتل کے درمیان فیصلہ فرما۔

desc.en: Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (a) also said that Allah’s Prophet (s) said…

arabic.text: وَ يَـحْكُمُ لِابْنَتِيْ فَاطِمَةَ وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ۔

lines.rarabic: WA YAH-KOMO LAB-NATEE FATEMATA WA RABBIL KA’BAH.

trans.en: I swear by the Lord of the Kaaba that Allah (swt) will rule in favour of my daughter Fatema (s).
trans.rurdu: Aur Kaabe ke Rab ki qasam Woh meri beti Fatema (s.a) ke silsile mein faisla karega.
trans.urdu: اور رب کعبہ کی قسم وہ میری بیٹی فاطمہ کے سلسلہ میں فیصلہ کرے گا۔

desc.en: Abul Qasim Ta’ee on the authoirity of his father, who on the authority of Imam Reza (a) who on the authority of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (a) narrated that the Holy Prophet (s) said: Moosa, the son of Imran (a) asked his Lord, the Honorable the Exalted: O Lord! My brother Haaroon has died. Please forgive him. Allah, the High, revealed to him…

arabic.text: يَا مُوسٰى لَوْ سَاَلْتَنِيْ فِيْ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ وَالْآخِرِيْنَ لَاَجَبْتُكَ مَا خَلَا قَاتِلَ الْـحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَبِيْ طَالِبٍ عَلَیْہِمَا السَّلَامُ فَاِنِّيْ اَنْتَقِمُ لَهٗ مِنْ قَاتِلِهٖ۔

lines.rarabic: YAA MOOSAA LAU SA-ALTA-NEE FIL AWWA-LEENA WAL AAKHE-REENA LA-AJAB-TOKA MAA KHA-LAA QAATE-LAL HUSAIY-NIBNE ALIYYIB-NE ABEE TAALE-BIN A’LAIY-HE MAS-SALAAMO FA-INNEE ANTA-QEMO LAHU MIN QAATELE-HI.

trans.en: O Moosa! If you ask Me to forgive any of those of the old or those of later times I would forgive them except for the murderers of Imam Hussain ibn Ali ibn Abi Talib (a). I will take revenge on his murderers.
trans.rurdu: Ay Moosa (a.s)! Agar Tum awwaleen o aakhereen ke mutaliq sawaal karte to mai jawaab deta keh mai be-shak qaatil’e Husain ibne Ali ibne Abi Talib (a.s) se unke khoon ka badla lunga.
trans.urdu: اے موسٰی! اگر تم چاہو  کہ میں تمام اولین و آخرین کو بخش دوں، تو میں اُنہیں بخش دونگا سوئے امام حسین ابن علی ابن ابی طالبؑ کے قاتلوں کے، میں اُن کے قاتلوں سے (ضرور) انتقام لونگا۔
